description: Reviews text for formats that do not travel across locales. Pass `text` and optionally `locales` (BCP 47 tags, comma-separated) and `currency` (ISO 4217 code, default USD). Flags numeric dates that could be day-first or month-first, English month-first dates, ordinals like 4th, mixed 12 and 24 hour clocks, comma versus period grouping used together, symbol before and after amounts, bare $ signs, percent spacing, imperial units, hard-coded plurals such as item(s) and 'x days ago', and US phone formats. Then prints a table of a fixed date, number and currency amount in each locale using the runtime's Intl data, so you can see what the same value looks like. English text patterns only; Intl output can vary a little by platform version.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the amount sample. Default USD.

locales.description: Comma-separated BCP 47 tags. Default is 13 common locales.

name: review_date_number_formats
title: Date and number format review
